title: review: F4 fix round 1: update test_scorecard's goal-table snapshot for the new calls/waste_pct/turns columns (gate red on T-0248)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 8dddf28 "Show gate measurements in task and goal scorecard tables" (T-0248) in git log; if not, run git checkout -B task/T-0251 task/T-0248. Never drop that commit.
T-0248 changed orchestrator/cli.py so `orchestrator scorecard --by goal` prints goal/usd/execute%/review%/spec_review%/scout%/other%/planner_runs/calls/waste_pct/turns and --by task appends calls/waste_pct/blocked/turns. Its gate failed on one pre-existing test: tests/test_scorecard.py::test_by_goal_cli_output_has_numeric_cell (about line 206) asserts the old 8-column header and len(cells) == 8.
Change: update that test to the new header string and 11 cells, and assert the three new cells render '-' (no gate log, no turns in that run record) so the snapshot covers the empty case; if any other test in tests/test_scorecard.py or tests/test_cli.py pins the old --by task header, update it the same way. Do not change cli.py unless a test reveals a real defect in the T-0248 rendering (say so in the final message if you do).
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 8dddf28 below your commit
tests/test_scorecard.py::test_by_goal_cli_output_has_numeric_cell passes against the new 11-column header and asserts the new cells
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: _scorecard_measurement_totals re-reads every tasks/T-*.json file and recomputes scorecard.by_task()/_gate_stats() from scratch on every 'goal' scorecard render (duplicating work by_goal() already did to build card). Not a correctness bug (verified against by_task/by_goal semantics and all 59 tests in test_cli.py/test_scorecard.py pass), just an avoidable full re-scan for a display-only total row.
